expression.gene_id_type: Sanger SIDG gene identifiers; symbols retained separately
expression.preprocessing: Merged wide TPM member; unique SIDM profiles as supplied; select response SIDMs; validate nonnegative TPM, no infinities and observed profile sums within 2% of 1e6; log2(TPM+1) once; transpose. Preserve partial missing values; no outcome-based filtering, cross-sample scaling or imputation.
expression.input_scale_evidence: Historical TPM member with unlogged abundances and profile sums approximately 1e6; current documentation concerns newer releases.
